purpose: Validate the remote topology, seeded data, scenario correctness, and metrics pipeline before the target run.
pre_run_steps: Created two isolated temporary RDS PostgreSQL 18.3 databases for OLTP and aggregate projection work.
Provisioned separate c7g.xlarge EC2 instances for the API plus NATS and for k6.
Deployed the exact git commit recorded above and enabled the pprof endpoint.
Started NATS 2.11.17 with JetStream on the API host.
Applied OLTP and projection migrations to the temporary databases.
Verified the API health endpoint and private network path from the k6 host.
Ran a 15 second warm-up followed by a 15 second measured test at 1,000 requested operations per second.
